scope: Six single-attempt Global answers and six same-model BM25 answers; no indexing, embeddings, repair or retries
fullstar_cost: Not calculated, as requested; all provider token usage recorded
embedding_budget: No new embeddings; prior cumulative official OpenAI budget remains USD 1
transport: Existing direct Responses SSE adapter; map JSON is required by unchanged official prompt but not enforced by a new transport schema. Official Global json_mode=False avoids a duplicated keyword in this pinned version; _map_response_single_batch still passes response_format_json_object=True, accepted and recorded by adapter. Reduce stream uses the complete validated response as one async chunk. No upstream prompts, parsing, report batching or reduce selection are replaced.
failure_policy: Abort on transport/response/budget/unknown result; no resume or replay. Retain upstream parsing failures and canned abstention without repair.
output_limit_risk: Prior authorized proxy behavior can exceed requested 2048 tokens; preserve actual complete response and usage, mark violations. No truncation or retry.

evaluation.rubric: Frozen atomic requirements, each 0 absent/wrong, 0.5 partial, 1 correct; report per question and group only. Independent AI reviewer checks source grounded factual errors, omissions, unsupported assertions and citation grounding. Not a human benchmark.
evaluation.citations: Separate named correct source locations from direct source excerpt citations and community-report citations. A Reports ID is not automatically verified source evidence. No retrieval-recall pooling with prior 20 questions.
evaluation.baseline: Same model, exact common user question/instruction, requested output cap and 12000 data cap; BM25 direct source once versus Global seven report map requests plus reduce. Different prompts and total compute are explicitly not controlled; no causal graph-only comparison.
evaluation.selection: Three earlier prespecified precise cases plus adapted F02 planning; two prospective auth-wide questions. Earlier retrieval results are known; this is a purposive exploratory extension, not a fresh blind test.
evaluation.independence: Gold is never loaded by execution script; no tuning or index rebuild using new questions.
